description: Figure 3 displays the distribution of input stimulus material types provided by journalists to Large Language Models (LLMs), as represented across WildChat conversations matched to online articles from two news agencies. The chart consists of five slices, representing the categories of days from generation to publication: 0, 1, 2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-10, 11-14, 15-30, and 38+. The slices are colored in shades of blue, ranging from light to dark. The slice representing 0 days has the highest proportion, approximately 40%, while the slice for 1 day represents around 30%. The remaining slices, representing 2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-10, 11-14, 15-30, and 38+ days, have proportions of approximately 10%, 5%, 5%, 5%, 2%, 2%, and 2% respectively. The chart includes a legend labeling each slice with its corresponding day range. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion.
